name: harborview-clinic-protocol-answers
description: Use for protocol-bound clinical decision-support tasks against the Harborview synthetic-clinic runtime API. Each task names a target case id and provides an answer_template.json contract; the job is to retrieve the case from the clinic runtime, apply the case's machine-readable clinic protocol, filter out seeded distractor records, and emit exactly one JSON object that conforms to the template. Covers the recurring families: adult respiratory / CAP assessment, pediatric head-injury triage, potassium repletion & escalation, care-management routing, and observation-window / protocol-gate retrieval.
